tooltip.voltaicdynamics.pocket_accumulat: Charges the items you hold and the armor you wear.
tooltip.voltaicdynamics.thermoelectric.d: Generates passive FE via the Seebeck thermal gradient.
Place next to Hot (Lava/Magma/Fire) and Cold (Ice/Snow/Water) blocks.
Heat and cold sources slowly wear out: lava cools, ice melts.
tooltip.voltaicdynamics.combustion.desc1: Burns solid fuel to generate %s FE/t.
tooltip.voltaicdynamics.combustion.desc2: Right-click to open the control panel.
tooltip.voltaicdynamics.electric_furnace: Smelts any furnace recipe using %s FE/t.
tooltip.voltaicdynamics.accumulator.tran: Transfer rate: %s FE/t. Feeds machines and cables, never other batteries.
tooltip.voltaicdynamics.accumulator.keep: Keeps its charge when broken. Comparator reads the charge.
tooltip.voltaicdynamics.voltaic_cable.de: Moves up to %s FE/t per connection.
Connects to any Forge Energy block: Mekanism, Powah, AE2 and more.
info.voltaicdynamics.voltaic_dust: Crafted from Iron Dust + Copper Dust + Redstone. Without an ore-processing mod, ingots work too (one dust). Smelt it into a Voltaic Ingot, or skip it with the Alloy Smelter.
info.voltaicdynamics.galvanic_alloy: Tier component of the Advanced Accumulator and the Electric Furnace. Smelt or blast Galvanic Dust to make it.
info.voltaicdynamics.thermoelectric_gene: Generates FE from a hot block and a cold block next to it: lava, fire or magma for heat; ice, snow or water for cold. Up to 100 FE/t. The sources slowly wear out.
info.voltaicdynamics.combustion_generato: Burns any furnace fuel for 40 FE/t. Lava buckets give the empty bucket back, and it pauses when full instead of wasting fuel.
info.voltaicdynamics.basic_accumulator: Stores 1,000,000 FE and keeps it when broken. Feeds machines and cables, never other batteries. Its slots charge and empty items.
info.voltaicdynamics.advanced_accumulato: Stores 8,000,000 FE with 10,000 FE/t transfer and keeps it when broken. Feeds machines and cables, never other batteries.
info.voltaicdynamics.voltaic_cable: Connected cables form one network that delivers energy in the same tick: machines first, batteries with what is left. Connects to any Forge Energy block.
info.voltaicdynamics.pocket_accumulator: Personal 100,000 FE battery. While in your inventory it charges the items in your hands and the armor you wear.
config.jade.plugin_voltaicdynamics.tank_: Fluid Tank icon shows its fluid
tooltip.voltaicdynamics.side_config: Faces configurable in the GUI (side tab).
tooltip.voltaicdynamics.alloy_smelter.de: Makes alloys from up to 3 ingredients using %s FE/t.
Iron + Copper + Redstone ingots become Voltaic Ingots, no dust needed.
tooltip.voltaicdynamics.fluid_tank.desc: Holds %s mB of one fluid and keeps it when broken.
Sneak + right-click an arm: deliver → pull (orange) → off.
No items in transit, no ticking cables: lag-free.
sideconfig.voltaicdynamics.title: Configuration
sideconfig.voltaicdynamics.eject_hint: Pushes out of every output face on its own.
cable.voltaicdynamics.nothing: Nothing to connect on this side
info.voltaicdynamics.alloy_smelter: Combines up to three ingredients into alloys with FE: Iron + Copper + Redstone gives 2 Voltaic Ingots, Voltaic Ingot + Gold + Redstone gives 2 Galvanic Alloy. Dusts give more. Packs can add recipes of type voltaicdynamics:alloying.
info.voltaicdynamics.fluid_tank: Stores 32,000 mB of one fluid and keeps it when broken. Right-click with a bucket, or use the GUI slots. Faces and auto-eject are set in the side tab.
info.voltaicdynamics.item_cable: Sneak + right-click the arm touching an inventory to make it pull (orange connector). Items go straight to the other connectors, round-robin, with no items in transit.
info.voltaicdynamics.fluid_cable: Sneak + right-click the arm touching a tank to make it pull (orange connector). Moves 1,000 mB/t per pulling connector to the other connectors.
tooltip.voltaicdynamics.voltaic_wrench.c: Right-click an item or fluid cable arm: deliver / pull / off
tooltip.voltaicdynamics.voltaic_wrench.d: Sneak + right-click a Voltaic block: pick it up
info.voltaicdynamics.voltaic_wrench: Right-click a machine to turn it a quarter turn; its side configuration turns with it. Right-click (sneaking or not) the arm of an item or fluid cable to cycle it: deliver, pull (orange connector), off. Sneak + right-click any other Voltaic block to pick it up straight into your inventory, energy and fluid included. Works as a wrench for other mods too (c:tools/wrench).
tooltip.voltaicdynamics.pulverizer.desc1: Crushes ores, raw metals and ingots into dusts using %s FE/t.
tooltip.voltaicdynamics.pulverizer.desc2: Ore: 2 dusts. Raw metal: 1 dust, 50% chance of a second.
info.voltaicdynamics.pulverizer: Crushes with FE: an ore block gives 2 dusts, a raw metal 1 dust with a 50% chance of a second, an ingot 1 dust. Smelt the dusts into ingots, or mix Iron and Copper Dust with Redstone into Voltaic Dust. Also turns cobblestone into gravel and gravel into sand or flint. Packs can add recipes of type voltaicdynamics:crushing.
tooltip.voltaicdynamics.speed_upgrade: +50% speed each; FE/t rises with it, FE per operation stays the same.
tooltip.voltaicdynamics.upgrade.where: Electric Furnace, Alloy Smelter, Pulverizer: up to %s of each type count.
info.voltaicdynamics.speed_upgrade: Goes in the upgrade slots of the Electric Furnace, Alloy Smelter and Pulverizer. Each one makes the machine 50% faster (up to 3x with four); FE/t rises by the same factor, so each operation costs the same energy.
info.voltaicdynamics.efficiency_upgrade: Goes in the upgrade slots of the Electric Furnace, Alloy Smelter and Pulverizer. Each one cuts the FE/t by 15% (60% less with four). Combine with Speed Upgrades for fast and cheap machines.
Burns liquid fuel: lava gives %s FE/t, %s FE per bucket.
Fed by pipes, fluid cables, buckets or the GUI slot.
info.voltaicdynamics.fluid_generator: Burns liquid fuel into FE: lava gives 80 FE/t and 200,000 FE per bucket, twice as fast as the Combustion Generator and without anyone feeding it buckets. Takes fuel from pipes, fluid cables, buckets clicked on it or containers in its slot. Packs can add other fuels to the voltaicdynamics:fluid_fuels data map.
tooltip.voltaicdynamics.accumulator.crea: Never runs out: gives %s FE/t and swallows what it gets. Also fills other batteries.
tooltip.voltaicdynamics.creative_tank.de: Fill it once with any fluid and it gives that fluid forever. Sneak + right-click with an empty hand to clear it.
tooltip.voltaicdynamics.tier_installer.h: Right-click a %s Electric Furnace, Alloy Smelter or Pulverizer to raise it. It keeps everything inside.
info.voltaicdynamics.elite_accumulator: Stores 32,000,000 FE with 32,000 FE/t transfer and keeps it when broken. Feeds machines and cables, never other batteries.
info.voltaicdynamics.ultimate_accumulato: Stores 128,000,000 FE with 128,000 FE/t transfer and keeps it when broken. Feeds machines and cables, never other batteries.
info.voltaicdynamics.creative_accumulato: Creative only. Never runs out: gives 1,000,000 FE/t out of every output face, fills other Accumulators and swallows any energy sent into it. Handy for testing builds.
info.voltaicdynamics.advanced_fluid_tank: Stores 64,000 mB of one fluid (2 Fluid Tanks) and keeps it when broken.
info.voltaicdynamics.elite_fluid_tank: Stores 128,000 mB of one fluid (4 Fluid Tanks) and keeps it when broken.
info.voltaicdynamics.ultimate_fluid_tank: Stores 256,000 mB of one fluid (8 Fluid Tanks) and keeps it when broken.
info.voltaicdynamics.creative_fluid_tank: Creative only. The first fluid it gets fills it forever: it gives that fluid without running down and swallows more of it. Sneak + right-click with an empty hand to clear it.
info.voltaicdynamics.advanced_tier_insta: Right-click a Basic Electric Furnace, Alloy Smelter or Pulverizer: it becomes Advanced and processes 2 items at once. FE/t doubles with it, so each item costs the same energy. Speed and Efficiency Upgrades still work on top.
info.voltaicdynamics.elite_tier_installe: Right-click an Advanced machine: it becomes Elite and processes 4 items at once.
info.voltaicdynamics.ultimate_tier_insta: Right-click an Elite machine: it becomes Ultimate and processes 8 items at once.
